// THE PERSON BEHIND THE BRANDS

About Bhavya

I'm Bhavya Goel — a 10-year-old coder and AI builder from India. I taught myself to build websites and work with AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, and turned that into two real, live brands: Bhavy Website Solutions, where I build websites and apps for real clients, and BG Fame, where I teach other people how to use AI well.

I'm not doing this because someone told me to — I just like building things and shipping them into the world. When I'm not coding, I'm making videos for my YouTube channels, learning new AI tools, or planning what I'll build next.
